docs.purpose: Shows the same nearby permits as the feed, but plotted as coloured pins on a full-screen map instead of a list. Tapping a pin opens that permit's detail page. A small settings button in the corner opens the same distance filter used on the feed. When the user's location is unknown the map centres on downtown Toronto.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing from the database directly. Every value arrives through one contract: `/api/leads/feed`. Behind that contract, the data comes from `coa_applications`, `cost_estimates`, `entities`, `entity_projects`, `lead_views`, `neighbourhoods`, `permit_trades`, `permits`, `trade_forecasts`, `trades`, `user_profiles` and `wsib_registry`. It also holds client-side state in `filterStore` and `authStore`, which is the part a server-driven projection has to absorb or justify. It emits **no analytics event**, so nothing it does is currently countable.
docs.under_126: **REBUILD** — it holds Layer-3 state (`filterStore` and `authStore`), so a client decision has to be re-homed on the server before the projection can be honest. It renders through the LIST renderer (a collection with declared pagination, recycling and empty/offline states), reading by reference: `/api/leads/feed`. Its `owns.components[]` declares `mobile/src/components/feed/LeadMapPane.tsx`.

emits: mobile/app/(app)/map.tsx:1-119 — no track() call in the file

identity.owner: unassigned (no CODEOWNERS file and no owner registry exists in the repo — measured 2026-09-15)

versioning.why: It renders the same LeadFeedResult payload as the feed tab and is bound by the same Zod mirror; a removed field breaks both surfaces together.

inputs.why: It re-reads the identical ["lead-feed", params] query the feed tab populates — no second contract, no device-only source beyond the GPS fix that parameterises the key.

outputs.why: The map writes nothing: its only interactions are opening the filter sheet (which owns its own write) and pushing to the lead detail route.

state.why: radiusKm and tradeSlug come from the MMKV-persisted filterStore and the query is gated on authStore.accessToken; the only component state is the filter-sheet open boolean.

staleness.why: Same cache entry as the feed tab — global 5-minute staleTime, 24-hour gcTime; the map never issues its own refetch.

session.why: Every contract it reaches sits under the `/api/leads` or `/api/user-profile` prefix, which route-guard classifies `authenticated`; the client additionally gates the query on authStore.accessToken so nothing fires before Supabase resolves.

rls_class.why: It reaches the same default-deny pipeline tables as the feed through the same route; nothing user-owned is read except lead_views inside the API layer.

guards.rate_bucket: leads-feed:{uid} — 30/min, 60s window (shared bucket with the feed tab)

checks.why: It consumes the payload the feed schema tests already pin (mobile/__tests__/schemas.test.ts, useLeadFeed.test.ts); no map-specific parse exists because there is no map-specific contract.
Measured absence: when the feed returns zero permits the map renders an empty Toronto view with no copy at all — there is no empty state to lock.
OfflineBanner is mounted inside the overlay SafeAreaView (map.tsx:113) and mobile/__tests__/offline.test.ts locks the persister that backs it.

errors.why: The screen destructures only `data` from useLeadFeed — isError is never read, so a failed feed fetch renders an empty map with no error affordance.

emits.why: No track() call exists in map.tsx; tab focus is not instrumented and marker taps emit nothing.

offers.why: No sponsored placement is rendered: the only slot component in the Expo tree is SponsorSlot, and it returns null unless EXPO_PUBLIC_PARCEL_SPONSORS=1.

metering.why: Nothing here is counted: the Spec 126 §7 usage ledger table does not exist (grep for usage_events in the introspected drizzle schema returns 0 hits), and the only quota-shaped counter, user_profiles.lead_views_count, is incremented solely by POST /api/leads/view, which has no mobile caller.

config.why: The surface consumes no registered logic variable: the only server-side tunable in this path, user_profiles.radius_cap_km, is a per-user admin column, not a logic_variables row.

sharing.why: It is the second renderer of /api/leads/feed — the property MAX-SERVER-SIDE depends on, since one projection already feeds two visually different surfaces.
sharing.varies_by_surface: The map consumes only the geo + phase subset of the payload and drops every permit whose latitude or longitude is null.

limitations.what: A feed error is invisible on the map: the screen shows an empty Toronto region instead of an error state.
limitations.measured: map.tsx:42 destructures `{ data }` only — isError/isLoading are never read.

notes: This surface renders three components it does not own — LeadMapPane (owned here), plus LeadFilterSheet and OfflineBanner which are their own census rows. The 44x44 filter FAB is the measured minimum touch target (map.tsx:106).
